# Q2 Project Status Report — Action Items

## Summary

The migration to the new ingest pipeline is on track. End-to-end latency dropped 30% after the caching layer landed, and error rates are within target. The remaining risk is the data-backfill window.

## Action Items

- [ ] **Alice:** Finalize the production rollout plan by June 20.
- [ ] **Bob:** Add monitoring dashboards for the new pipeline.
- [ ] **Carol:** Update the on-call runbook and notify support.
